content:
Platform setup is a one-time operation performed by a DrorPay admin. The third-party developer does NOT do this themselves — they receive credentials after the admin completes setup.

Steps:
1. Admin creates the platform: POST /admin/platform/create
2. Admin generates the platform secret: POST /admin/platform/generate-secret
3. Admin shares three credentials with the developer: platform JWT token, platform secret, platform slug
4. Admin optionally tests the webhook: POST /admin/platform/test-webhook

After receiving credentials, the developer can use the /platform/v1/* endpoints without any further admin involvement.

Create Platform (admin only): POST /admin/platform/create

Request body:
- name (string, required): Platform display name
- business_id (string UUID, required): UUID of the DrorPay business linked to this platform
- description (string, optional): Platform description
- payment_callback_url (string, optional): Webhook URL for payment event notifications. Can be added/updated later.

Response includes: platform id (UUID), slug (auto-generated from name), is_active status.

The platform secret is NOT set at creation — it must be generated separately using POST /admin/platform/generate-secret.

Generate Platform Secret (admin only): POST /admin/platform/generate-secret

Request body: { "platformId": "<uuid>" }

Response: { "secret": "<raw_secret_string>" }

Critical behavior:
- The raw secret string is returned ONLY once at generation time
- DrorPay stores a hashed version — the raw value cannot be retrieved again
- If regenerated, the previous secret is immediately invalidated — all API calls using the old secret will fail
- The developer must store this value securely on their side
- Send this value as-is in the X-Platform-Secret header — do not encode it

After setup, the developer needs three credentials for all /platform/v1/* API calls:

1. platform_jwt_token
   A JWT containing the platform_user_id claim. Obtained by authenticating as a platform user.
   Used as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

2. platform_secret
   The raw string returned once during secret generation.
   Used as: X-Platform-Secret: <secret>

3. platform_slug
   Auto-generated from the platform name during creation.
   Used as: X-Platform-Code: <slug>

All three must be present on every request. They are independent values — losing any one requires contacting the DrorPay admin (the JWT can be regenerated by re-authenticating; the secret requires admin regeneration).
